item.title: Admin demolishes illegal eco-retreat at Talamali
item.description: Koraput: In a decisive action against land encroachment, the Koraput administration has demolished an illegal eco-retreat that had come up at Talamali, a major tourist attraction in Semiliguda block, officials said Friday. item.description: New Delhi: In view of the surge in passenger demand following widespread flight cancellations, the Indian Railways has deployed 116 additional coaches in 37 premium trains operating over 114 enhanced trips across the country. item.title: Centre releases over Rs 68,000 crore to states under MGNREGA: Kamlesh Paswan
item.description: New Delhi: The Centre has released Rs 68,393.67 crore to states and Union Territories so far under the flagship rural employment scheme MGNREGA, Minister of State for Rural Development Kamlesh Paswan said Friday. item.description: New Delhi: Russia agreed to encourage joint manufacturing in India of military hardware and spare parts for the maintenance of Russian-origin arms and defence equipment. item.title: DRDO hands over seven underwater, naval technologies to Indian armed forces
item.description: New Delhi: From a long-life seawater battery system for sustained underwater sensing and surveillance applications to a waterjet propulsion system for fast interceptor craft, the DRDO has handed over seven technologies to the armed forces, the government said. These technologies have been developed under the Technology Development Fund (TDF) scheme, the defence ministry said Friday. […]

item.description: New Delhi: The Enforcement Directorate Saturday said it has filed a chargesheet against businessman Anil Ambani’s group company, Reliance Power Ltd. and 10 others in a money laundering case linked to the issuance of an alleged fake bank guarantee of Rs 68 crore for securing a tender. item.description: Mumbai: Domestic carrier IndiGo has cancelled over 200 flights from Delhi and Mumbai Saturday, a day after managing to temporarily secure major relaxations in the second phase of the court-mandated new flight duty and rest period norms for cockpit crew, sources said. item.title: IndiGo resumes nine flights from Jammu Airport, cancels seven from Srinagar
item.description: Jammu/Srinagar: IndiGo Saturday announced the resumption of nine of its 11 flights from the Jammu Airport, but cancelled seven flights from Srinagar, owing to the nationwide disruptions caused by the airline’s pilot-rostering issues. item.description: Islamabad: A heavy exchange of fire between Pakistani and Afghan forces was reported from the key Chaman border, according to a media report on Saturday.
